name: vc01_prefix_arbitrary_element
interpretation: Any final element value preserves initialized-prefix shape, for arbitrary capacity and length.

name: vc02_capacity_preserved
interpretation: Shape borrowing does not change capacity or length.

name: vc03_frame_outside_element
interpretation: Loan relation frames every different index.

name: vc05_sorted_arbitrary_element
interpretation: SortedVec cannot give out arbitrary &mut element with no pledge.

name: vc06_sorted_with_constrained_final
interpretation: Neighbor bounds on the final value preserve arbitrary-length sortedness; an unrestricted loan supplies no such bounds.

name: vc07_no_circular_invariant_assumption
interpretation: Entry proof alone cannot certify a clearing mutation.
model:
[index = 7719,
 length = 7720,
 final_initialized = Store(Store(K(Int, True), 7720, False),
                           7719,
                           False),
 capacity = 7721,
 entry_initialized = Store(K(Int, True), 7720, False)]

name: vc08_circular_premise_vacuously_hides_bug
interpretation: Negative control: assuming the suspended invariant hides the error.

name: vc10_initialized_does_not_imply_no_panic
interpretation: An initialized input is compatible with a panicking callee.
model:

name: vc11_enclosing_invariant
interpretation: Preserving the child positivity invariant can break its parent bound.

name: vc12_two_loans_joint_obligation
interpretation: Two separately valid entry-based checks do not imply joint restoration.

name: vc13_distinct_reborrow_final_values
interpretation: The two loan IDs cannot share one final-value symbol.

name: vc15_future_data_liar

name: vc16_cache_needs_actual_loan_end_update
